items.sm: Creates a department for incoming Councilmember Anna Albi and moves $66,885 from Councilmember Liz Keating's office budget to fund it.

items.t: Move $400,000 to a fleet electrification plan
items.sm: Moves $400,000 from a sustainability capital project to the Office of Environment and Sustainability for a City fleet electrification plan.

items.t: Pay $63,916.59 to Envirosuite for Lunken Airport services
items.sm: Authorizes a payment of $63,916.59 to Envirosuite for services at Lunken Airport.

items.t: Accept a $558,751 grant for downtown and OTR EV chargers
items.sm: Creates a capital project and accepts an OKI grant of up to $558,751 for electric vehicle chargers in parking facilities in Over-the-Rhine and downtown.

items.t: Apply for a $100,000 grant for the Roberts Academy dental center
items.sm: Authorizes a grant of up to $100,000 from the Cincinnati Dental Society's Oral Health Foundation for equipment at the Roberts Academy dental center.

items.t: Accept a $500,000 brownfields assessment grant
items.sm: Accepts an EPA Brownfields Community-Wide Assessment grant of up to $500,000.

items.t: Accept a $4,500 school-response training grant
items.sm: Accepts a state school safety grant of up to $4,500 for police tactical team school-response training.

items.t: Accept Music Hall space for the 2024 inaugural session
items.sm: Accepts event space worth $2,750 from the Cincinnati Arts Association for the 2024 Council inaugural session at Music Hall on January 2, 2024.

items.t: Let the City Manager set right-of-way permit fees
items.sm: Amends street and vehicle code sections so the City Manager can set fees to recover the cost of permits and licenses for work in the right-of-way.

items.t: Report on finances through September 30, 2023
items.sm: Presents the finance and budget monitoring report for the period ending September 30, 2023.

items.t: Add community engagement to the easement process
items.sm: Asks the Administration to add community engagement and tree replacement guidelines to its process for granting easements for large construction.

items.t: Allocate $200,000 for shelter, oral health and neighborhood programs
items.sm: Asks that $200,000 in contingency funds go $75,000 to Bethany House, $60,000 to CincySmiles, $25,000 to Invest in Neighborhoods and $40,000 to historic preservation.

items.t: Require reporting of lost or stolen guns
items.sm: Requires owners to report lost or stolen firearms to police and makes failure to do so a civil offense.

items.t: Charge a fee to return seized firearms
items.sm: Adds a fee to cover the City's cost of processing requests to return firearms, including ownership and eligibility checks.

items.t: Name Avondale Avenue at Reading Road Shirley A. Merrick Way
items.sm: Gives Avondale Avenue at Reading Road in North Avondale the honorary name Shirley A. Merrick Way for her public service.
